knownGaps.why: DEFECT, not a limitation — recorded only so the shared suite stays green; see the SaaS capture report. Three tiers spanning one order of magnitude ($0, $10, $16) render in two shapes because a zero price ignores the page grid: autoDecimals() returns a hardcoded 2 for amount === 0, so the free tier reads "0.00 ZEC" in a column of "0.0128 ZEC". Nothing about this page forces two shapes.
